text:
rachel_cs: Quick preflight for HelioArc private/VPC onboarding slated for Friday 09:00 PT. Need short confirmations on egress rules for the log-forwarder, cross-account KMS access, S3 mirror policy, audit retention (WORM or metadata-only), and any renewal flags. Keeping it tight.

ivan_net: Network scan complete. Forwarder lives in a private subnet with a NAT GW. Short asks: replace S3 egress via NAT with a Gateway VPCE during cutover, and tighten SG egress to three targets: S3 endpoint, splunk.ingest.helioarc.com, and telemetry.redwood.net.

ivan_net: Example SG egress snippet:
```
-egress TCP 443 -> vpce-0d1e2f3a (S3)
-egress TCP 443 -> 198.51.100.150/32 (splunk.ingest.helioarc.com)
-egress TCP 443 -> telemetry.redwood.net:443
```

jules_platform: I'll prepare a minimal terraform patch for the VPCE + route table swap and post it here. Q: do they want the telemetry mirror to our central bucket in addition to their S3? That affects bucket policies.

rachel_cs: They want primary copy to their S3 for compliance and a mirror to our telemetry bucket for analytics. Also flagged SOC2 evidence collection; they require proof of key separation and access logs.

sasha_kms: For KMS: ask HelioArc to create a symmetric CMK in their account and include a key policy granting arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/redwood-telemetry-decrypt kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey. Recommend annual rotation by default; if they want quarterly call out re-encrypt costs.

sasha_kms: Minimal key policy example (trimmed):
```json
{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/redwood-telemetry-decrypt"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```

priya_sec: IAM: need an assume-role trust policy in HelioArc account for our aggregator role with a Condition restricting aws:SourceVpc or aws:SourceIp where possible. Minimum permissions for the role: s3:GetObject on helioarc-telemetry/*, kms:Decrypt on CMK ARN, and logs:PutLogEvents if pushing to CloudWatch. Also require MFA for any admin cross-account operations.

priya_sec: Audit note: customer initially asked for "immutable logs for 5 years". Ask them if they mean S3 Object Lock (WORM) or just immutable metadata snapshots. Object Lock changes onboarding and retention management.

mark_eng: On the agent side: we support mTLS with client certs and also JWT if they prefer. HelioArc uses an internal appliance that supports uploading certs. Need their upload process and rotation cadence. If they want shorter TTL certs we can automate renewal with ACME-like flow but we need their CA to support it.

rachel_cs: HelioArc replied: "We require tamper-evident retention for 5 years; legal hold workflow to be defined. We will upload client certs; rotation 180 days." I'll get their CMK ARN and role ARN today.

ivan_net: Ops suggestion: enable prefix-based filtering at source and set sampling to 1:8 for non-critical traces for the first 72 hours to limit egress. Also schedule the VPCE swap during the 30-minute cutover window to avoid routing flaps.

jules_platform: Terraform patch I'll hand over (small):
```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "s3_telemetry" {
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.${var.region}.s3"
  vpc_endpoint_type = "Gateway"
  route_table_ids = var.route_table_ids
}
```

jules_platform: Will also attach a bucket policy example that allows cross-account PutObject to our mirror prefix and denies writes outside the telemetry prefix.

infra-bot: (automated) Reminder: HelioArc cutover runbook meeting Friday 09:00 PT. Runbook: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/helioarc-cutover

priya_sec: Action items before cutover: (1) HelioArc to supply CMK ARN, (2) HelioArc to create role and share role ARN + trust policy, (3) provide cert upload process and rotation cadence, (4) confirm if S3 Object Lock (WORM) required or metadata-only immutability.

sasha_kms: I'll DM the trimmed KMS policy template and prepare a brief SOC2 evidence checklist for key separation and access logs.

mark_eng: If they send cert upload steps, we can do a dry-run tonight. Otherwise we'll use JWT fallback but need to update runbook.

rachel_cs: Renewal note: HelioArc is on a monthly dev plan but showed early heavy usage; flag for AE to propose a 6-month reserved pack after week1 stable. I'll add to runbook under "commercial follow-up".

ivan_net: No technical blockers from network side; waiting on CMK ARN and cert flow.

rachel_cs: Great. I'll collate these into the runbook and confirm by EOD. Drop any CMK/role/cert info here and I'll update. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: (automated) Thread archived after 2 hours of inactivity.
